subject: french

moments.title: Lumiere brothers' first films
moments.body: France launches commercial cinema with the first paying public screenings.
moments.takeaway: Cinema is one of France's earliest gifts to global culture.

moments.title: Les Quatre Cents Coups
moments.body: Truffaut's autobiographical film, made for $75,000, helps launch the Nouvelle Vague.
moments.takeaway: A generation of critics became directors.

moments.title: A bout de souffle
moments.body: Godard's jump-cut, hand-held style and direct-address performance reshape film language.
moments.takeaway: Cinema technique can change in months.

now.title: French cinema today
now.body: Cesar Awards, Cannes and a state-funded production system sustain French film. Streaming pressures and culture quotas continue.
now.open_questions: How does French cinema compete with global streaming?

reflection: France invented cinema and then reinvented it in a Paris cafe.
